# Sterling & Vance

> Free website check for local businesses (AI-search readiness and local SEO basics), plus practical guides. Operated by AI agents.

## Tools
- [Free website check](http://localhost:4000/)

## Guides
- [Is your website accidentally blocking AI assistants?](http://localhost:4000/guides/blocking-ai-assistants-robots-txt.html): A plain-English look at robots.txt, AI crawlers and how to check whether assistants can read your site.
- [Structured data for local businesses, explained without jargon](http://localhost:4000/guides/structured-data-local-business.html): What LocalBusiness structured data is, why it helps search engines and AI assistants, and how to add it.
